findings.title: myColorado ID app latest on batch of online outages (FOX31 via Yahoo News)
findings.summary_md: FOX31 reported on November 19, 2026 that a state spokesperson confirmed the myColorado ID app had gone down just before noon that Thursday. The spokesperson described it as an outage with a team working to restore service, and the article said the cause had not been specified. The report predates the state's November 23 acknowledgment of a cybersecurity incident.

findings.title: myColorado Mobile App Temporarily Unavailable, Office of Information Technology Thoroughly Investigating
findings.summary_md: Colorado OIT's November 23, 2026 release said an unauthorized user accessed platform data in the myColorado app and that OIT discovered the incident on the evening of November 18. The app was shut down while OIT investigated, and the release said people whose data was affected would be notified once the investigation was complete. It told users to carry physical licenses or state IDs and pointed air travelers to alternate DMV-approved wallets.

findings.title: Latest Outage Update on the myColorado site
findings.summary_md: The myColorado site's November 23, 2026 update said the app would remain unavailable while the state investigated a cybersecurity incident and determined the full impact. It gave no confirmed restoration timeline and told users to carry physical ID, use agency websites and online portals such as the DMV site, and watch the page for daily updates. The notice framed the outage as a security investigation rather than routine maintenance.

findings.title: myColorado Mobile App Temporarily Unavailable, Office of Information Technology Thoroughly Investigating (KKTV)
findings.summary_md: KKTV published OIT's statement at 8:54 PM MST on November 23, 2026, estimating that 50,000 to 150,000 of the app's roughly 2.1 million users may have had data affected. It relayed Sarah Tuneberg's statement that systems would return once security was restored. The article advised physical ID for verification, adding an mDL to a DMV-approved wallet for flights, and TSA ConfirmID at a $45 fee for travelers lacking acceptable ID.
